title: Made some familiar locations using AI with other images I've found here.
content: Based on the first image in [this post](https://www.reddit.com/r/TheMallWorld/comments/1nga3un/i_love_dreaming_about_these_places/) (credit to /u/JustTheAATIP) as well as one of the pictures that was crossposted here a while ago from the University of Amsterdam. The first picture here (with the glass ceiling) looks similar to a wide open mall-courtyard area I found once after slipping through a crack in a wall in my old elementary school.
